intent: Leave the farm lane for a narrow hedgeway, pass through its tunnels and gaps, climb over the hedge and return to the countryside. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

sections.name: The open farm lane
sections.lesson: Find the entrance between the farm hedges. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

signs.text:
The open farm lane
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

sections.name: The narrow hedge corridor
sections.lesson: Short precise hops follow the enclosed lane. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

signs.text:
The narrow hedge corridor
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

sections.name: Gaps through the hedge
sections.lesson: Drop through the hedge’s separated tunnels. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

signs.text:
Gaps through the hedge
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

sections.name: The raised hedge-top route
sections.lesson: Climb onto the clear tops above the tunnel. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

signs.text:
The raised hedge-top route
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

sections.name: The countryside exit
sections.lesson: The lane opens into another field. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

signs.text:
The countryside exit
